title: A股港股早报：AI光通信财报接力，存储激光雷达映射与油价风险并行 + 美股盘前：CPI符合预期，AI基建财报接力领涨
summary: Futunn Sparks 显示体育博彩、加密矿企、存储、SOL 储备和激光雷达领涨；公开报道显示中东与霍尔木兹不确定性推升油价，美股指数在 CPI 前小幅回落，但 Lumentum、Super Micro、CoreWeave 盘后反馈支持 AI 光通信和服务器链。A/H 关注光模块/CPO、存储、激光雷达、平台互联网与能源防御的开盘验证。 美股盘前：CPI基本符合预期，CRWV、SMCI、LITE盘前强反馈带动AI云、服务器和光通信；今晚关注CSCO与COHR的beat概率和指引质量。

entries.title_en: A/H Morning Brief: AI Optics Earnings Lead, Storage and Lidar Map to Asia While Oil Risk Persists
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
霍尔木兹不确定性继续推升油价风险
8月11日美股收盘报道显示，伊朗与美国围绕霍尔木兹海峡的条件仍未明朗，WTI 约83.4美元、布伦特一度重上90美元附近；A/H 映射到中海油、中国石油、中国石化、油服、航运成本和通胀预期。
国际
美国 CPI 前指数回落，成长估值仍看美债方向
道指跌约0.34%、标普500跌约0.32%、纳指跌约0.6%；油价与通胀数据叠加，使恒生科技和 A 股高估值科技早盘需要先看美债收益率与美元是否继续施压。
科技
隔夜 Sparks 显示存储与激光雷达进入强势映射线
Futunn Sparks 正数 Top5 为体育博彩 +3.04%、加密矿企 +2.85%、存储概念 +2.56%、SOL 储备 +2.39%、激光雷达 +2.35%；其中存储映射兆易创新、江波龙、澜起科技，激光雷达映射速腾聚创、禾赛与智能驾驶链。
科技
AI 光通信财报强但高预期仍需价格确认
Lumentum 公布收入约10.1亿美元、调整 EPS 3.23美元并高于预期，下一季指引也强；对 A/H CPO、光模块、交换机和算力硬件偏利多，但盘后股价反应不强，说明高位预期需要中际旭创、新易盛、天孚通信开盘承接验证。
科技
Super Micro 与 CoreWeave 强反馈支撑 AI 服务器链
公开报道显示 Super Micro 盘后因强指引涨约7.6%，CoreWeave 收入超预期后盘后涨约15.5%；A/H 映射到工业富联、浪潮信息、液冷、电源、PCB 与数据中心上游。
科技
加密矿企与 SOL 储备走强偏情绪弹性
Sparks 加密矿企 +2.85%、SOL 储备 +2.39%，代表股 CIFR +5.39%、VSA +12.80%；A/H 只可轻映射到港股加密金融、算力租赁和风险偏好，不宜替代有业绩验证的 AI 硬件主线。
财报
可验证 A/H 重要财报结果不足
本机 Futu OpenD 未启动，HK/SH/SZ 财报日历与 NOTICE 搜索均返回 127.0.0.1:11111 connection refused；公开检查未确认腾讯、阿里、美团、小米、中芯国际、华虹等恒生科技权重昨收后有正式业绩结果，因此不使用美股公司财报补位。
科技
消费与太空压力样本提示风险偏好不均衡
公开报道显示 On Holding 因销售和指引下调跌超20%，AppLovin 跌约6%，Rocket Lab 盘后因 Neutron 延迟担忧跌超5%；A/H 智能驾驶、广告科技和高估值成长若不能放量修复，仍需控制追高。

盘前结论

最清晰的利多来自 AI 基建财报，光通信、服务器和存储链同时获得 Lumentum、Super Micro、CoreWeave 的新验证。宏观约束仍是 CPI 前的油价通胀风险，高估值科技不能只因盘后财报利好就无量追高。

Sparks 存储和激光雷达给 A/H 增加映射弹性，但加密、SOL 和体育博彩更偏情绪主题，必须用成交额确认是否能转成本地主线。

Futu 财报和公告检查因 OpenD 未启动受限，今日按“可验证 A/H 重要财报结果不足”处理，不用美股公司财报补位。

重点个股推荐

中际旭创
300308.SZ
CPO验证

推荐理由：AI 光通信财报强，若低开后迅速修复，可确认国内光模块景气没有被高预期完全透支。

触发因素：Lumentum 收入、EPS 和指引均高于预期，CPO 是 A/H 最直接映射链。

风险点：若放量冲高回落，说明机构交易拥挤，需防止带动新易盛、天孚通信补跌。

工业富联
601138.SH
AI服务器

推荐理由：Super Micro 与 CoreWeave 反馈偏强，服务器、液冷、电源和数据中心订单链有望获得映射。

触发因素：SMCI 强指引、CRWV 收入超预期，验证 AI 基建资本开支韧性。

风险点：若 A 股算力硬件高开无量，容易出现兑现而非趋势扩散。

兆易创新
603986.SH
存储映射

推荐理由：Sparks 存储概念进入正数 Top5，给 A 股存储芯片和模组链提供开盘情绪。

触发因素：SKHY 领涨存储板块，AI 服务器需求也强化 HBM/DRAM 逻辑。

风险点：存储价格与业绩兑现若跟不上，短线主题可能快速降温。

速腾聚创
2498.HK
激光雷达

推荐理由：Sparks 激光雷达 +2.35%，智能驾驶传感器链在港股有直接观察标的。

触发因素：OUST +7.12% 带动海外 lidar 情绪，港股开盘看成交额和汽车链联动。

风险点：若新能源汽车链整体偏弱，单一主题很难独立持续。

中国海洋石油
0883.HK
能源防御

推荐理由：油价风险溢价仍高，能源央企和高股息资源股可作为成长波动的对冲仓。

触发因素：霍尔木兹消息、WTI 上行和美股能源相对强势是直接触发。

风险点：若海峡谈判快速缓和或油价回落，能源股高开后可能承压。

板块轮动看板

受益方向AI 光通信、AI 服务器、存储、激光雷达、油气高股息
观察方向平台互联网、港股 SaaS、加密金融、SOL 主题映射
压力方向高估值消费成长、广告科技、太空链、无业绩主题股
验证信号恒生科技成交额、CPO 龙头承接、油价亚洲盘、南向资金流向

逻辑链

美国 CPI 前指数回落、油价上行，A/H 早盘先面临利率和能源通胀约束。
Lumentum、Super Micro、CoreWeave 盘后强反馈，把科技映射从泛 AI 收敛到光通信、服务器和存储链。
Sparks 存储和激光雷达进入正数 Top5，给 A 股存储、港股 lidar 与智能驾驶提供补充弹性。
消费、广告科技和太空压力样本较弱，说明风险偏好不是全面扩张，追高需要成交验证。
若 CPO/服务器龙头高开有量且油价不再冲高，资金可回到科技；若高开回落，则能源防御和低估值更占优。

风险雷达

油价冲击通胀

霍尔木兹消息若继续推高油价，美债收益率会压制港股成长和 A 股高估值科技。

AI 硬件预期拥挤

强财报若不能带来持续上涨，说明 CPO、服务器和存储链需要防范兑现。

Futu 公告检查受限

OpenD 未启动导致本地财报日历和 NOTICE 无法验证，盘中需补看交易所公告。

消费需求压力

On Holding 暴跌提示海外消费预期偏弱，港股消费和广告链不宜只按风险偏好修复交易。

主题映射失真

加密矿企、SOL 和体育博彩对 A/H 基本面映射有限，若资金不接力容易快速回落。

entries.html_en:
Major News
International
Hormuz uncertainty keeps oil-risk premium elevated
August 11 US market reports showed US-Iran conditions around the Strait of Hormuz still unresolved, with WTI near $83.4 and Brent briefly back around $90; A/H mapping runs through CNOOC, PetroChina, Sinopec, oil services, shipping costs and inflation expectations.
International
Indexes slipped before US CPI, leaving growth valuations rate-sensitive
The Dow fell about 0.34%, the S&P 500 about 0.32%, and the Nasdaq about 0.6%; crude and inflation data mean HSTECH and high-multiple A-share technology need confirmation from Treasury yields and the dollar.
Technology
Sparks shows storage and lidar entering the stronger mapping lanes
Futunn Sparks positive Top5 were Sports Betting +3.04%, Crypto Mining +2.85%, Data Storage +2.56%, SOL Reserve +2.39%, and Lidar +2.35%; storage maps to GigaDevice, Longsys and Montage, while lidar maps to RoboSense, Hesai and smart-driving suppliers.
Technology
AI optical earnings were strong, but high expectations still need price confirmation
Lumentum reported about $1.01 billion of revenue and adjusted EPS of $3.23, above estimates, with strong next-quarter guidance; this is positive for A/H CPO, optical modules, switches and compute hardware, but muted after-hours price action means high expectations need validation from Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink and TFC Optical.
Technology
Super Micro and CoreWeave feedback supports the AI server chain
Public reports showed Super Micro up about 7.6% after hours on strong guidance and CoreWeave up about 15.5% after beating revenue expectations; A/H mapping includes Foxconn Industrial Internet, Inspur, liquid cooling, power, PCB and data-center suppliers.
Technology
Crypto miners and SOL reserve names are sentiment beta
Sparks showed Crypto Mining +2.85% and SOL Reserve +2.39%, with CIFR +5.39% and VSA +12.80%; the A/H read-through is only a light sentiment map to Hong Kong crypto finance, compute leasing and risk appetite, not a replacement for earnings-backed AI hardware.
Earnings
Verifiable major A/H earnings results were insufficient
Local Futu OpenD was not running, and HK/SH/SZ earnings-calendar plus NOTICE checks returned 127.0.0.1:11111 connection refused; public checks did not confirm formal post-close results from Tencent, Alibaba, Meituan, Xiaomi, SMIC or Hua Hong, so US earnings are not used as A/H earnings filler.
Technology
Consumer and space pressure samples show uneven risk appetite
Public reports showed On Holding down more than 20% on sales and guidance, AppLovin down about 6%, and Rocket Lab down more than 5% after hours on Neutron-delay concerns; A/H smart driving, ad-tech and high-multiple growth need volume-backed repair before chasing.

Pre-Market View

The clearest positive input is AI infrastructure earnings: optics, servers and storage now have fresh validation from Lumentum, Super Micro and CoreWeave.The macro constraint is still oil-driven inflation risk before CPI, so high-multiple technology should not be chased without opening support.

Sparks storage and lidar add A/H mapping beta, but crypto, SOL and sports betting are more sentiment-driven and need turnover confirmation before becoming a local theme.

Futu earnings and notice checks were limited because OpenD was not running, so today uses the verifiable A/H earnings-gap treatment and avoids filling the module with US-company earnings.

Trigger：Lumentum beat revenue, EPS and guidance, making CPO the most direct A/H read-through.

Risk：A high-volume fade would signal crowded positioning and could drag Eoptolink and TFC Optical.

Trigger：SMCI guided strongly and CRWV beat revenue, validating AI infrastructure capex resilience.

Risk：If A-share compute hardware gaps up without volume, profit-taking may dominate.

Trigger：SKHY led the storage theme, while AI server demand reinforces HBM/DRAM logic.

Risk：If memory pricing and earnings delivery lag, the theme can cool quickly.

RoboSense

Risk：If the NEV chain is broadly weak, a single lidar theme may not sustain.

CNOOC

Rationale：Crude-risk premium remains high, so energy SOEs and high-dividend resources can hedge growth volatility.

Trigger：Hormuz headlines, higher WTI and US energy relative strength are the direct triggers.

Risk：If strait negotiations improve quickly or crude falls, energy shares may fade after a strong open.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesAI optics, AI servers, storage, lidar, high-dividend oil and gas
WatchInternet platforms, Hong Kong SaaS, crypto finance, SOL theme read-through
PressureHigh-multiple consumer growth, ad tech, space chain, non-earnings themes
SignalsHSTECH turnover, CPO leader support, Asia crude trading, southbound flows

Logic Chain

US indexes slipped before CPI while crude rose, so A/H first faces rate and energy-inflation constraints.
Strong after-hours feedback from Lumentum, Super Micro and CoreWeave narrows the tech map from generic AI to optics, servers and storage.
Sparks storage and lidar in the positive Top5 add beta for A-share memory, Hong Kong lidar and smart driving.
Weak consumer, ad-tech and space samples show risk appetite is not broad, so chasing needs volume confirmation.
If CPO/server leaders gap up with volume and crude stops rising, capital can rotate back to technology; if they fade, energy defense and low valuation should lead.

Risk Radar

Oil lifts inflation

If Hormuz headlines keep lifting crude, Treasury yields can pressure Hong Kong growth and high-multiple A-share technology.

Crowded AI hardware

If strong earnings cannot drive sustained gains, CPO, servers and storage need profit-taking risk controls.

Futu checks limited

OpenD was not running, so local earnings calendars and NOTICE checks could not be verified; exchange notices need intraday follow-up.

Consumer demand risk

On Holding's plunge flags weaker overseas consumption expectations; Hong Kong consumer and ad names should not be traded only as risk-on repair.

Theme mapping risk

Crypto miners, SOL and sports betting have limited A/H fundamental mapping and can fade quickly without follow-through.

entries.title_en: US Premarket: In-Line CPI and AI Infrastructure Earnings Lead
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
宏观
7月CPI基本符合预期，盘前风险偏好修复但未解除利率约束
7月CPI同比约3.4%、核心CPI同比约2.5%，月度读数未明显超预期；股指期货在数据后延续小幅上涨，但通胀仍高于美联储目标，9月政策分歧没有消失。
指数
纳指期货领涨，AI财报把盘前焦点重新拉回科技硬件
公开盘前报道显示纳指期货涨幅约0.7%，标普500约0.3%，道指约0.2%；CoreWeave、Super Micro 和 Lumentum 的强反馈使科技权重重新占优。
AI
CoreWeave (CRWV) 收入超预期并上调指引，盘前大涨约18%-19%
CRWV二季度收入约25.8亿美元、亏损小于预期，并披露订单积压和新增承诺继续扩张；价格反馈强，说明AI云和GPU租赁需求仍被市场认可。
AI
Super Micro Computer (SMCI) 强财报和强指引带动AI服务器链
SMCI盘前涨约9%，市场把它作为AI服务器、液冷、电源、PCB与英伟达供应链需求的验证点；但开盘后仍要观察毛利和库存担忧是否被重新交易。
光通信
Lumentum (LITE) 财报后涨约8%，光通信和CPO情绪明显修复
LITE财报和指引均好于预期，盘前涨幅接近8%；Coherent、Corning、Marvell等相关光通信/互连标的也获得带动，AI数据中心光互连成为今天科技主线之一。
芯片
英伟达伙伴链同步走强，SMH/半导体承接是开盘第一验证
CRWV、SMCI、LITE均与AI算力资本开支相关，给NVDA、MRVL、AVGO等上游和互连链条提供情绪支撑；若SMH强于纳指，科技轮动可延续。
商品
油价仍是通胀尾部风险，能源强势会压制高估值追涨
中东与航运扰动使布伦特和WTI维持高位，AP报道提到布伦特约89美元、WTI约83美元；油价未明显回落前，成长股反弹更适合看作财报驱动而非估值全面扩张。
利率
10年期美债约4.67%，CPI后没有给成长股单边放松信号
10年期美债收益率较高位回落但仍在约4.67%附近，美元相对稳定；这支持风险偏好修复，却不足以让无盈利软件和小盘成长无差别上行。
财报
今晚科技财报样本集中在 Cisco (CSCO) 与 Coherent (COHR)
Cisco确认盘后发布财报，市场预期约每股1.17美元、收入约168亿美元；Coherent确认美股收盘后发布四季度和全年业绩，是AI光通信链的直接延续样本。
风险
CAVA等消费股强反馈不能掩盖油价和实际工资压力
CAVA盘前大涨显示部分消费服务仍有韧性，但油价、汽油价格和实际工资压力会继续影响消费股估值；今天不宜把消费股统一写成顺周期主线。

盘前结论

CPI符合预期和AI财报强反馈，使今天开盘基调偏强震荡，科技重新获得领涨资格。但利率仍高、油价仍高，指数上涨更像“有业绩价格确认的科技修复”，不是全面估值扩张。

盘前价格反馈最明确的是CRWV、SMCI和LITE，分别对应AI云、AI服务器和光通信；NVDA作为上游锚点可承接外溢资金。若这些高开标的开盘后快速回补缺口，说明市场在卖事实，软件和小盘成长也会被动降温。

今晚财报重点放在CSCO和COHR：前者验证AI网络和安全需求，后者验证LITE之后的光通信链持续性。

推荐理由：盘前大涨约18%-19%，说明市场认可收入超预期、亏损小于预期和订单积压扩张，适合做AI云风险偏好锚。

触发因素：若开盘后能守住高开区间且NVDA/SMCI同步强，资金会继续交易GPU租赁和AI云容量稀缺。

推荐理由：CRWV、SMCI、LITE的共同指向都是AI资本开支仍强，NVDA是上游订单和情绪的核心承接标的。

触发因素：若纳指强于标普且半导体ETF不弱，NVDA更容易吸收从财报赢家外溢出来的配置资金。

风险点：估值高、政策和出口限制敏感；若10年期美债上行或AI硬件高开回落，NVDA也会同步承压。

压力方向无盈利软件、小盘成长、消费运输和油价敏感板块；利率与能源仍是估值上限。
验证信号CPI后10Y美债是否稳定、SMH是否强于纳指、CRWV/SMCI/LITE是否守住高开。

逻辑链

CPI符合预期解除最坏通胀冲击，但3.4%的同比读数仍让美联储保持数据依赖。
CRWV、SMCI、LITE的盘前涨幅把科技交易从泛AI重新收敛到AI云、服务器和光互连。
10年期美债和油价仍限制估值扩张，因此多头应优先选择已经有价格正反馈的财报链。
今晚CSCO和COHR会继续验证AI网络与光通信，如果指引不弱，科技轮动可延续到互连和网络设备。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下为基于已知一致预期、历史surprise、近期指引、卖方修正、行业景气和盘前价格反馈的判断，不是事实承诺。

高概率Cisco Systems (CSCO)：AI网络订单、园区交换升级和安全软件需求仍强，上一季订单与AI基础设施线索较好；基于一致预期约1.17美元EPS和约168亿美元收入，beat概率偏高，但若FY2027指引保守，盘后反应可能被压制。
中高概率Coherent (COHR)：今晚收盘后发布FY2026四季度和全年业绩，LITE已用强财报验证AI光互连需求，COHR历史EPS beat频率较高；但近期涨幅和光通信高预期意味着收入或毛利指引必须同步强，才容易形成正向盘后反馈。
低概率样本不足已检查 Nasdaq、MarketWatch、Investing.com、Kiplinger、公司IR和公开财报日历；StubHub、Air Canada等虽在今晚日程中，但不属于科技公司样本，Applied Materials (AMAT) 为8月13日盘后，不纳入今天盘后beat分层。

风险雷达

CPI后利率反弹

如果10年期美债在开盘后重新上行，AI硬件和软件的高估值会被压缩。

AI财报卖事实

CRWV、SMCI、LITE若高开后放量回落，说明好消息已被提前计入，相关链条应降仓观察。

油价通胀尾险

中东和航运扰动若继续推高布伦特/WTI，会削弱消费、运输和成长股风险偏好。

今晚指引风险

CSCO或COHR即使EPS beat，若订单、毛利或下一财年指引保守，也可能拖累网络设备和光通信链。

entries.html_en:
Major News
Macro
July CPI matched expectations, lifting risk appetite without removing rate constraints
July CPI was about 3.4% year over year and core CPI about 2.5%, with monthly readings not materially hotter than expected; stock futures held modest gains after the release, but inflation remains above the Fed target and September policy uncertainty persists.
Indexes
Nasdaq futures led as AI earnings pulled focus back to technology hardware
Public premarket reports showed Nasdaq futures up about 0.7%, S&P 500 futures about 0.3%, and Dow futures about 0.2%; strong CoreWeave, Super Micro and Lumentum reactions put technology leadership back in front.
AI
CoreWeave (CRWV) beat revenue and raised guidance, rising about 18%-19% premarket
CRWV reported roughly $2.58 billion of Q2 revenue, a smaller-than-expected loss, and continued expansion in backlog and new commitments; the strong price reaction confirms demand for AI cloud and GPU rental capacity remains valued by the market.
AI
Super Micro Computer (SMCI) rallied on strong earnings and guidance
SMCI rose about 9% premarket, becoming a validation point for AI servers, liquid cooling, power, PCB and the Nvidia supply chain; after the open, margin and inventory concerns still need monitoring.
Optics
Lumentum (LITE) gained about 8% after earnings, repairing optics and CPO sentiment
LITE beat earnings and guidance expectations and traded up nearly 8% premarket; related optics and interconnect names including Coherent, Corning and Marvell also benefited, making AI data-center optical interconnects a key tech lane.
Semis
Nvidia partner chain strengthened; SMH and semis are the first opening test
CRWV, SMCI and LITE are all tied to AI compute capex, supporting sentiment for NVDA, MRVL, AVGO and interconnect suppliers; if SMH outperforms the Nasdaq, the tech rotation can extend.
Commodities
Oil remains the inflation tail risk, limiting high-multiple chasing
Middle East and shipping disruptions kept Brent and WTI elevated, with AP citing Brent near $89 and WTI near $83; until crude clearly retreats, growth-stock upside is better treated as earnings-driven rather than broad multiple expansion.
Rates
The 10-year Treasury near 4.67% gives growth no one-way easing signal
The 10-year Treasury yield eased from highs but stayed near 4.67%, while the dollar was relatively stable; that supports risk repair but not indiscriminate upside for unprofitable software and small-cap growth.
Earnings
Tonight’s tech earnings sample centers on Cisco (CSCO) and Coherent (COHR)
Cisco is confirmed to report after the close, with expectations around $1.17 EPS and roughly $16.8 billion of revenue; Coherent is confirmed to release fiscal Q4 and full-year results after the NYSE close, making it the direct continuation sample for AI optics.
Risk
Strong CAVA reaction does not erase oil and real-wage pressure
CAVA’s premarket jump shows some consumer-service resilience, but oil, gasoline prices and real-wage pressure still affect consumer valuations; today’s consumer trade should not be generalized into a broad cyclical leadership call.

Pre-Market View

In-line CPI and strong AI earnings set up a firmer, choppy open and put technology back in leadership position.But rates and crude remain elevated, so index upside looks more like earnings-confirmed tech repair than broad multiple expansion.

The clearest premarket price confirmation is in CRWV, SMCI and LITE, mapping to AI cloud, AI servers and optics; NVDA is the upstream anchor for spillover demand.If these gap-up names quickly fill their gaps after the open, the market is selling the news and software plus small-cap growth will cool as well.

Tonight’s earnings focus is CSCO and COHR: Cisco tests AI networking and security demand, while Coherent tests whether the optics chain can extend after LITE.

Focus Stocks

CoreWeave
CRWV
AI cloud strength

Rationale: Premarket gains around 18%-19% show the market is rewarding the revenue beat, smaller loss and backlog expansion, making it an AI cloud risk-appetite anchor.

Trigger: If it holds the gap after the open while NVDA and SMCI stay firm, investors can keep trading GPU rental scarcity and AI cloud capacity.

Risk: Capex, financing costs and customer concentration remain high; a fast gap fade would turn it into an earnings-selloff risk.

Super Micro Computer
SMCI
AI server validation

Rationale: Strong earnings and guidance produced roughly 9% premarket upside, the clearest price confirmation for AI servers and liquid-cooling suppliers today.

Trigger: If SMH outperforms and SMCI does not fill the gap, AI hardware can shift from expectation trading to earnings validation.

Risk: Margins, inventory and delivery cadence remain in focus; a volume reversal would show heavy expectation pressure.

Lumentum
LITE
Optics repair

Rationale: After earnings and guidance beat expectations, the stock rose about 8% premarket, turning AI data-center optical interconnects from narrative into price confirmation.

Trigger: If COHR, MRVL and GLW also strengthen, LITE can stay a front-line CPO and optical-module trade.

Risk: Optics names have rallied sharply; weak COHR guidance tonight would create second-round volatility.

NVIDIA
NVDA
Capex anchor

Rationale: CRWV, SMCI and LITE all point to resilient AI capex, making NVDA the central upstream order and sentiment anchor.

Trigger: If the Nasdaq leads the S&P 500 and semiconductor ETFs hold firm, NVDA can absorb allocation spillover from earnings winners.

Risk: Valuation, policy and export controls remain sensitive; higher Treasury yields or AI hardware gap fades would pressure NVDA too.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength to WatchAI cloud, AI servers, optical interconnects and semiconductor links; CRWV, SMCI, LITE and NVDA are the main price anchors.
Event-DrivenCSCO and COHR test AI networking, campus switching, optical modules and data-center interconnect demand after the close.
PressureUnprofitable software, small-cap growth, consumer transport and oil-sensitive groups; rates and energy still cap valuations.
SignalsWhether the 10-year Treasury stabilizes after CPI, whether SMH beats the Nasdaq, and whether CRWV/SMCI/LITE hold their gaps.

Logic Chain

In-line CPI removes the worst inflation shock, but a 3.4% year-over-year rate keeps the Fed data-dependent.
CRWV, SMCI and LITE premarket gains refocus technology trading from generic AI to AI cloud, servers and optical interconnects.
The 10-year Treasury and crude still limit multiple expansion, so longs should prioritize earnings chains with positive price feedback.
Tonight CSCO and COHR will further test AI networking and optics; if guidance is firm, tech rotation can extend into interconnects and networking equipment.

After-Hours Earnings Beat Probability

The following is a judgment based on consensus expectations, historical surprise, recent guidance, sell-side revisions, industry conditions and premarket price feedback, not a factual promise.

High ProbabilityCisco Systems (CSCO): AI networking orders, campus switching refresh and security software demand remain strong, with prior-quarter order and AI infrastructure signals supportive; against expectations around $1.17 EPS and roughly $16.8 billion revenue, beat probability looks above average, but conservative FY2027 guidance could cap the reaction.
Medium-High ProbabilityCoherent (COHR): The company reports FY2026 Q4 and full-year results after the close, and LITE has already validated AI optical-interconnect demand; COHR has a strong recent EPS beat record, but recent gains and high optics expectations mean revenue or margin guidance must also be strong for a positive after-hours reaction.
Low / Limited SampleChecked Nasdaq, MarketWatch, Investing.com, Kiplinger, company IR pages and public earnings calendars; StubHub and Air Canada appear on tonight’s schedule but are not technology samples, while Applied Materials (AMAT) reports after the close on August 13 and is not included in today’s after-close beat tiers.

Risk Radar

Post-CPI rate rebound

If the 10-year Treasury yield rises again after the open, high-multiple AI hardware and software will face valuation compression.

AI earnings sell-the-news

If CRWV, SMCI and LITE gap up then reverse on volume, good news was already priced and related chains should be downgraded to watch.

Oil inflation tail risk

If Middle East and shipping disruptions keep lifting Brent and WTI, consumer, transport and growth risk appetite will weaken.

Tonight guidance risk

Even if CSCO or COHR beat EPS, conservative orders, margins or next-year guidance could weigh on networking and optics.
